acquisition_note: Every official and reference NFL host (nfl.com, espn.com) is denied by the org egress policy. Corroboration came from agreement across independent publisher titles and URL slugs.
grade_scope: MARKET_BENCHMARK_ONLY — no NFL model identity exists in the registry and no immutable pregame probability card is registered. Brier, log loss, edge and EV are NULL BY RULE, not omitted by oversight.

games_pregame_at_capture.benchmark_null_reason: NO_ATTRIBUTABLE_LINE — no same-book spread or moneyline was acquired. A benchmark side requires a capture-time line; a snippet-only or unattributable price is EVIDENCE ONLY and cannot produce a selection (8/3 ruling).

games_already_kicked_not_registered: Week 2 reportedly carried ~10 games on this date, most kicking between 16:00Z and 23:00Z. Those are past kickoff and are NEVER registered.
enumeration_limitation: The full 10-game list could not be transcribed reliably: the available enumeration merged multiple games into single bullets, omitted a kickoff time for one, and its accompanying results paragraph mixed in five games that are not from 2026-08-22. Only the game whose kickoff time and venue were independently corroborated is recorded here.
